name: @gatedpath/preflight
description: Pre-flight checks before deploying to Redbelly Network (151 mainnet, 153 testnet): chain ID, deployer verification, Safe admin, compiler pins, secrets in git history, RBNT balance, Slither report.

scripts.build: node scripts/ensure-deps-built.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "for (const f of ['cli.js','doctor-cli.js','redbelly.js']) require('fs').chmodSync('dist/'+f,0o755)"
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-concurrency=1 test/unit.test.mjs test/preflight.test.mjs test/doctor.test.mjs test/gas.test.mjs test/ship.test.mjs
